in_hebrew.name: Maritsa
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Maritsa הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Maria', meaning 'bitter' or 'rebellious', but often used in reference to Mary, the mother of Jesus. The name 'Maritsa' can be translated as 'Mary's grace' or 'Mary's mercy'.

in_greek.name: Maria
in_greek.meaning: bitter, rebellious, star of the sea
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek μαριάμ (Mariam), which is derived from the Hebrew מריָם (Maryam), meaning 'rebellious' or 'bitter.' The name Maria also means 'star of the sea.' In Greek mythology, Maria is the name of the goddess of the sea.

in_latin.name: Mariah
in_latin.meaning: bitter, rebellious, star of the sea
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin Mariah, which is derived from the Greek Maria. Mariah means 'bitter,' 'rebellious,' or 'star of the sea' in Latin.
